'"Having pronounced this curse, Bhrigu was overcome with

brief.summary_1line: Durvasa recounts how Bhrigu cursed Vishnu to be born as Rama and suffer separation from his wife, explaining Rama’s destiny and future reign.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhrigu, furious and grief-stricken, raises his hand to curse Vishnu after finding his wife slain by the discus.
The radiant sage Durvasa sits beside Vasishtha in the hermitage as King Dasaratha respectfully asks about the destiny of his lineage.
At sunset Lakshmana and the charioteer pause beside the quiet banks of the Keshini River after discussing Rama’s fate.
